title: Preserve all video streams
summary: FR-016 now preserves all real source video streams by allowing multi-video source inventories, verifying remux/encode output real-video stream counts before publish, and failing closed when subtitle burn-in would collapse multiple real video streams to one filtered output.
reason: The old policy blocked multi-video inputs even though the remux and encode command topology already used real-video stream mapping. The decided FR-016 policy is preserve-all, so publish must be gated by output evidence rather than by rejecting multi-video sources up front.
behavior_before: Multi-video sources failed source video-stream policy with SOURCE_VIDEO_STREAMS_UNVETTED, and there was no remux/encode publish gate comparing real-video source and output stream counts.
behavior_after: Source video-stream policy accepts one or more real video streams once probeable, remux and encode block publish with OUTPUT_VIDEO_STREAM_COUNT_MISMATCH or OUTPUT_VIDEO_STREAM_PROBE_FAILED when output evidence cannot prove preserve-all, and subtitle burn-in blocks multi-video encode with SUBTITLE_BURN_MULTI_VIDEO_UNSUPPORTED.
manual_validation: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\ops\pipeline\tests\Invoke-ReliabilityRegressionChecks.ps1 - passed; includes FR-016 Tdarr-derived topology proof

pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\ops\pipeline\tests\Unit\Invoke-MediaVerificationSafetyChecks.ps1 - RED failed before pipeline wiring on missing output video-stream preservation assertion
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\ops\pipeline\tests\Unit\Invoke-MultiVideoTopologyChecks.ps1 - passed; SourceOrigin=tdarr-derived source=2 remux=2 encode=2
rollback_plan: Revert the media_probe.ps1 output-preservation helper/source-policy change, the remux.ps1 and encode.ps1 verification call sites, the new failure-code registry entries, and the FR-016 topology test/reliability wiring; then refresh generated summaries/maps and reopen FR-016 in the active checklist.
notes:
FR-016 preserve-all video stream policy, output verification, topology proof, docs, and generated context.
Validation used retained LocalBase Tdarr seed as read-only input and wrote only temp proof media under %TEMP%.
